schema_notes.barrier_class: HARD-BARRIER (removes capability; survives; required for mode=block rails) | FRICTION-ONLY (slows but doesn't prevent; requires signed waiver at .harness/scope-waivers.json if mode=block). Enforced by scripts/audit-rail-barrier-class.sh.
schema_notes.mode: block (fail-closed, hard gate) | warn (advisory, non-blocking) | shadow (runs silently, no output; judge rails only) | stub (not yet implemented — audit-rail-barrier-class treats stub as advisory only)

territory.description: An agent only edits files within its own territory (per docs/team/FILE-OWNERSHIP.md). Cross-territory edits require an explicit handoff to the file's owner.

design-tokens.description: No raw hex color values (#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}) outside two whitelisted locations: app/globals.css and components/WorldlineGlobe.tsx.

next-16-api.description: No deprecated Next.js API usage. Stub — awaiting Algol TS audit logic.

voice-discipline.description: NETRA voice patterns intact in prompts and components. Stub — awaiting NETRA voice spec + Algol TS audit logic.

accessibility-floor.description: Lighthouse a11y >= 95 for any new entry template. Stub — awaiting Lighthouse runner + Algol TS audit logic.

prototype-layer.description: Prototypes in prototypes/** stay vanilla: no .ts/.tsx files, no Next.js imports, no @/ aliases. Every prototype directory has a README.md.

prototype-production-diff.description: Visual drift between Betelgeuse prototype and Sirius production implementation. STUB — real pixel-diff logic deferred to META-11.

prototype-runtime.description: Prototype actually loads in a headless browser without console errors, page exceptions, or network failures. Corrects the harness gap where file existence + lint does not prove runtime correctness.

soul-atom-drift.description: Every appearance value (color/size/spacing/timing) in the soul-atom gallery (.claude/visual-diffs/soul-atlas/gallery.html) must resolve to a token_ref in app/globals.css OR a cited main_branch_ref in manifest.json. Uncited raw literals = FAIL. Exits 0 silently when soul-atlas/manifest.json does not exist (pre-Phase-1). Includes font-chain presence assertion (C1b) — see font-chain-presence rail.
soul-atom-drift.activation_notes: grep bug fixed (-- separator); exit-3 now blocking; visual-diff.sh wired; TS audit (Algol) invoked and propagated
soul-atom-drift.update_notes: C1b font-chain presence check wired; manifest schema bumped to v2 (production_ref field); render-fidelity gauntlet formalized in RAIL-DEFINITIONS.md
blocks_on: gallery.html added or modified under soul-atlas/

font-chain-presence.description: gallery.html must explicitly bind --font-display, --font-mono, --font-type in a :root {} block. Tailwind v4 @theme inline does not execute in static-serve context — without this binding all text atoms fall back to Times serif. Called as sub-check C1b by audit-soul-atom-drift.sh (not run standalone by harness-check.sh).
font-chain-presence.invocation: embedded — called by scripts/audit-soul-atom-drift.sh at step C1b
font-chain-presence.root_cause: TASK-2026-05-29-SOUL-FACTORY-FIDELITY: token-green gallery rendered all text in Times serif because @theme inline does not run outside Tailwind build pipeline

html-first-spec-discipline.description: Enforce directions/ discipline for the HTML-first spec workflow: each direction-N/README.md must declare soul-baseline (must resolve), connection-point, continuity, evolution, and bet. Blocking for Rule 4 soul-baseline violations; advisory for layout/STATUS hygiene.
html-first-spec-discipline.note: exits 0 silently on tasks without a directions/ directory — no false positives on pre-workflow artifacts

axiom-gate-join-coverage.description: Axiom↔gate bijection in both directions. Direction 1: every PROJECTED axiom must name ≥1 enforcing gate that exists in harness config. Direction 2: every gate must trace to ≥1 axiom or be in the DERIVED_IS list. UNPROJECTED/PARTIAL axioms past must_project_by = RED. Coverage assertion: all N axioms and all M gates must be visited.
axiom-gate-join-coverage.invocation_note: Pass TODAY override via env: TODAY_ISO=YYYY-MM-DD bash scripts/audit-axiom-gate-join-coverage.sh. Default: current date.

gauntlet-overlap-composition.description: No element renders over a higher-z sibling unless the pair is listed in .harness/allowed-overlaps.json with a documented reason. Playwright-backed: reads computed z-index and bounding rect from rendered DOM. Denominator: all z-indexed elements in snapshot. Coverage: elements_checked == N.

gauntlet-min-legible-size.description: All text and icon elements render at dimensions >= legibility floor at 4 breakpoints per docs/design/60-responsive-system.md. WIDE>=1180px: min 12px text / 16x16px icon. DESK 881-1179px: 12px / 16x16. MID 601-880px: 12px / 14x14. NARROW<=600px: 11px / 12x12. Playwright-backed. Denominator: all text+icon elements at each viewport; 4 assertions required.

gauntlet-sub-pixel-detection.description: All manifest atom x variant pairs render bounding rect >= 1x1px. Sub-pixel (any dimension < 1px) or zero-size elements are FAIL if manifest claims visible. Denominator: |manifest.atoms| x |variants_per_atom| Cartesian product. Coverage: pairs_checked == total. Playwright-backed.

permissions-nonempty.description: HARD gate: .claude/settings.json must have a non-empty permissions field with at least one deny rule. An absent or empty permissions block means every tool is implicitly allowed — the P3 least-privilege gap. Enforced by scripts/audit-permissions-nonempty.sh.

least-agency-config.description: Asserts: (1) .claude/settings.json contains at least one deny for curl and wget patterns, (2) a blocking PreToolUse Bash hook is present in settings.json. Fails closed if either condition is missing. Guards against regression after Wave 1 activation.

audit-ground-truth-observed.description: A TASK cannot close DONE for a shipped route unless a human (or automated headless observer) has produced a cryptographically-linked screenshot and acknowledged it. Asserts: (A) PNG exists at .claude/visual-diffs/<task_id>/observed/<route>.png, (B) observed.json exists and is valid JSON, (C) ack:true for every shipped route, (D) sha256 in observed.json matches the PNG on disk, (E) if task window is supplied, both PNG mtime and observed_at fall within the window.
audit-ground-truth-observed.control: Ground-truth observability — eliminates proxy-as-anchor (build green + HTTP 200 ≠ DONE)

audit-search-index-completeness.description: Asserts that the pagefind search index covers every crawlable HTML page in the Next.js build output. Two assertions: (1) page_count from pagefind-entry.json == crawlable HTML count in .next/server/app; (2) no data-pagefind-body element is hidden (display:none) or RSC-payload-only (unreachable to pagefind static crawler). Exits 3 (SKIP) when build output is absent — never false-passes on a missing build.
audit-search-index-completeness.live_wiring_gap: Requires completed npm run build (velite + next build + pagefind indexing). Wire: '... && npm run index:search && bash scripts/audit-search-index-completeness.sh' in CI post-build step.
audit-search-index-completeness.control: Search index completeness — eliminates partial-index silent failure (2 of 13 pages indexed)

single-source.description: For each artifact in .harness/single-source-registry.json, every copy found under the registered search paths must either (A) byte-match the canonical sha256 or (B) contain a textual import of the canonical module path. A divergent copy that neither matches nor imports the canonical is a FAIL. Scope: app/**, components/**, lib/**, prototypes/**, .claude/visual-diffs/** — production and in-tree handoff paths only. Git worktree checkouts (.claude/worktrees/**) are explicitly excluded from registry search globs.
single-source.scope_note: Git worktrees (.claude/worktrees/**) are parallel branch checkouts — branch divergence there is expected and MUST NOT be flagged. Only the main working tree is in scope.
single-source.control: Single-source enforcement — eliminates divergent blob accumulation across prototype, handoff, and visual-diff paths

secret-leak-guard.description: Scans ALL git-tracked files for SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY env-access patterns and the sb_secret_ key prefix. Asserts that SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY references appear ONLY under scripts/**. Any hit in app/**, lib/**, components/**, or the repo root is a FAIL. Spec §5.4/§11 (store-as-source S8). Comment-only mentions excluded via line-start detection.
secret-leak-guard.control: Secret containment — ensures SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY never leaks into app runtime bundle or tracked non-script files

dev-clobber-guard.description: Prevents a production build or serve from running while a 'next dev' process is alive. A live 'next dev' writes .next in dev mode; a subsequent 'next build' or 'next start' against the same directory will either clobber the dev artifacts or serve them, breaking production styling. On 2026-06-02 this served the entire site unstyled. Hook: .claude/hooks/dev-clobber-guard.sh (PreToolUse Bash, blocking). Trigger: next build|start, npm run build|start, pnpm/yarn build|start in command position. Check: ps scan for live next dev / next-server.*dev process.
dev-clobber-guard.invocation: PreToolUse Bash hook (registered in .claude/settings.json) — fires automatically before any Bash tool call
dev-clobber-guard.root_cause: 2026-06-02: next dev running alongside next build clobbered .next, serving whole site unstyled
dev-clobber-guard.control: Build environment isolation — prevents dev/prod .next clobber
